frequency_question: How often does a major proposed vehicle financing or subsidy scheme successfully finalize and implement within 31 months?
membership_rule: Includes central government transport/heavy industry ministry schemes targeting commercial electric vehicle adoption (buses/trucks) announced for development. Excludes state-level schemes.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named; believed to represent the complete set of comparable major national EV/commercial vehicle schemes in this category
known_gaps: Minor pilot programs are excluded by the scale threshold.
validity_reason: Policy implementation cadence for major vehicle subsidies has remained consistent over the last decade across administrations.
